verdict.rationale: Browserbase documents a first-party Agent created from the dashboard by describing a goal in natural language (docs-16). It runs on a schedule or on demand (docs-14), can pause to ask the user for input and then resume (docs-23), handles downloaded files (docs-27, docs-18), and can be refined with the in-dashboard Optimize tool (docs-25, docs-17). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the built-in Agent, evidence of a general conversational assistant beyond browser-task agents, and in-depth detail on task scope and limits.
